fact: At a workshop in Libreville on 21 May 2025 to validate a post-World Bank financing model for eGabon-SIS (a proposed levy of 10% of facility revenues plus insurer and other contributions, no state budget line stated), the system was reported in trial in about ten Libreville facilities: CHU Mère-Enfant Jeanne Ebori, CHU d'Owendo, the military hospitals of Akanda and PK9 and several health centres including Glass, in use there since January.
title: eGabon-SIS : Quel modèle économique après la phase de déploiement ?
